over_credit_limit.expect: Balance is above the Rs 3,000 limit: block new credit (POL-CREDIT-001 v2).

overdue_credit.expect: Dues are 52 days past due: no new credit; escalate to the owner.

legacy_credit_limit.expect: Rs 5,000 limit comes from policy v1; v2 says Rs 3,000. Flag for owner review.

reminder_sent_recently.expect: Overdue, but a reminder went out 2 days ago: wait until 7 days have passed.

duplicate_payment.expect: Two Rs 6,000 payments with the same UPI reference on the same day: likely a duplicate entry. Ask a person to check before changing the ledger.

duplicate_customer.expect: Same phone number on two customer records: suggest merging, do not merge alone.

returned_sale.expect: Returned within 7 days as defective: refund or replace (POL-RETURNS-001).

stock_count_mismatch.expect: Adjustment recorded after the count; investigate sales and receipts, open case.

negative_margin.expect: Selling below cost: propose a price within MRP; price changes need approval.

low_stock_no_po.expect: Below reorder level with no open purchase order: propose a reorder.

low_stock_no_po_dairy.expect: Below reorder level with no open purchase order: propose a reorder.

low_stock_with_open_po.expect: Already on order, arriving in 2 days: do not create another order.

late_purchase_order.expect: Delivery is 7 days late: follow up with the supplier before reordering.

short_delivery.expect: 10 reams missing: claim credit from the supplier (SOP-SHORT-001).

high_value_draft_po.expect: Orders over Rs 10,000 need the owner's approval (POL-APPROVAL-001).

dead_stock.expect: No sales in 90 days: suggest a discount or return to supplier; do not reorder.

inactive_product_with_stock.expect: Marked inactive but still has stock: ask whether to sell off or reactivate.
